content: rmcp Streamable HTTP server transport had DNS-rebinding vuln before 1.4.0 (no Host header validation) — GHSA-89vp-x53w-74fx; MCP spec REQUIRES Origin validation on all incoming connections; Host check blocks rebinding, Origin allowlist is defense-in-depth. Bind 127.0.0.1 only. Client quirks: Claude Code supports headersHelper for bearer tokens; Cursor http config differs; must test both.
